Wards With Most Potholes.sql:
SELECT ward AS ward,
       count(*) AS count
FROM   problems p
WHERE  has_location
  AND  category IN ('Potholes')
GROUP BY ward
ORDER BY count DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

Potholes by Month.sql:
SELECT to_char(reported_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata', 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
       count(*) AS count
FROM   problems p
WHERE  has_location
  AND  category IN ('Potholes')
GROUP BY to_char(reported_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata', 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY 1;

Slowest Categories To Fix.sql:
SELECT category AS category,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_to_close) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Resolved') AS median_days,
       count(*) AS complaints
FROM   problems p
WHERE  has_location
GROUP BY category
HAVING count(*) >= 100
ORDER BY median_days DESC NULLS LAST;

Wards With Lowest Fix Rate.sql:
SELECT ward AS ward,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Resolved') / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Resolved', 'Rejected')), 0), 1) AS fix_rate,
       count(*) AS complaints
FROM   problems p
WHERE  has_location
GROUP BY ward
HAVING count(*) >= 200
ORDER BY fix_rate ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

Hotspot Wards per 100k.sql:
SELECT ward AS ward,
       round(count(*) * 100000.0 / w.population, 1) AS per_100k,
       count(*) AS complaints
FROM   problems p JOIN wards w USING (ward)
WHERE  has_location
GROUP BY ward, w.population
ORDER BY per_100k DESC NULLS LAST;
-- then keep groups whose value ≥ mean + 0.5 × standard deviation

Open Backlog by Category.sql:
SELECT category AS category,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_open) AS open_now,
       count(*) AS complaints
FROM   problems p
WHERE  has_location
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY open_now DESC NULLS LAST;

Complaints by Hour of Day.sql:
SELECT extract(hour FROM reported_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS hour,
       count(*) AS count
FROM   problems p
WHERE  has_location
GROUP BY extract(hour FROM reported_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')
ORDER BY 1;

Filing Channel per Category.sql:
SELECT category AS category,
       channel AS channel,
       count(*) AS count
FROM   problems p
WHERE  has_location
GROUP BY category, channel
ORDER BY count DESC NULLS LAST;
